fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD -13.25%) became the target of a short report alleging firmware leaks to Chinese blacklisted manufacturers, but Reuters has not independently verified the claims, leaving evidence lacking.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMD's Q3 revenue increased 45% year-over-year to $13.4B, with net profit margin (non-GAAP) rising to 56% from 54%, though near-term share price weakness appears driven by rumors rather than fundamentals.
